gloss: to pass out from drinking; to drink oneself unconscious

definitions.gloss: to pass out from drinking; to drink oneself unconscious
definitions.explanation: To become so intoxicated from alcohol that one collapses or falls asleep. Implies drinking to excess beyond the point of functioning.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れた。
{飲|の}みすぎて{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れてしまった。
examples.english: I drank too much and passed out.

examples.japanese: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}で{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れた{同僚|どうりょう}をタクシーに{乗|の}せて{家|いえ}まで{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I put my colleague, who had passed out drunk at the year-end party, in a taxi and sent him home.

notes:
{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れる is a compound verb combining {酔|よ}う (to get drunk) and {潰|つぶ}れる (to collapse, to be crushed). It is an intransitive ichidan verb.

ASPECT (ている):
{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れている describes the resulting state of being passed out drunk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れて{寝|ね}る (to pass out and fall asleep)
- {酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れて{動|うご}けない (to be too drunk to move)

RELATED WORDS:
Compare with {泥酔|でいすい} (dead drunk — more formal, describes the state), and {酔|よ}いつぶす (transitive — to make someone pass out drunk).
